title: Bi-representable bi-multicategories
summary: We prove a two-dimensional version of Hermida's equivalence result on representable multicategories and classify its stricter versions. The obtained three-dimensional equivalence of the respective totality categories is of categories enriched over the multicategory $\mathsf{Bicat}$ of Verity. There is a basic enriched equivalence with respect to inherently lax monoidal pseudofunctors, and a one with respect to pseudo-monoidal pseudofunctors, related to the latter via the forgetful enriched functors.
